TEXAS INSTRUMENTS​
Experience 
 
Anushka Yadav​
BTECH Computer Engineering 
2022-2026

Eligibility Criteria 
CGPA : 6.00 + 
Branches : CS/IT 
 
Stipend  
INR : ₹ 60000 per Month 
PPO will be offered on performance basis 
 
Roles  
●​ Software Development Engineer 
●​ Data Engineer 
 
Location  
Banglore 
Do Note their Head Office is in Bangalore
 
1

Online Assessment - 6th August, 2024 
The duration of online assessment was about 90 mins. The login window was 30 mins. The 
topics covered during the assessment were aptitude, CS fundamentals and two DSA coding 
questions. First one was the two pointer problem and the second one was based on the basic for 
loop. The DSA questions were pretty easy and so were the rest of the mcq questions (Only single 
correct answer) 
As far as I remember there was no negative marking. We were asked to give the online 
assessment in college since it was offline due to which we needed to keep our laptops charged. I 
faced multiple issues before giving the tests. Most of those were related to system compatibility. 
So ensure your system is compatible before giving the test. They also provide a link to HirePro 
where you can check the compatibility of your system. 
The results were announced on 7th of August, 2024 at around 3pm. I was very excited and at the 
same time nervous since I was shortlisted for the first time for any company’s interview round. I 
already had my CS fundamentals revised because of interviews of previous companies for which 
I never got selected and also had my DSA basics revised. I also planned to review my resume 
once and solve the top 20 puzzles on geeks for geeks. 
Interview Round - 8th August, 2024 (Technical) 
On 8th August, 2024 I was very nervous because it was my first interview for a company. The 
interview was scheduled online. 
There were two panels of interviewers. I had been assigned Panel 2.After a long wait, my 
interview began at 12 noon. There were two interviewers. Both of them introduced themselves 
and then I was asked to give my introduction. One of the interviewers was very friendly and 
asked me to be stress free. The other one was from their ML team and began asking me 
questions on my resume. He even asked me to open my github repo of one of the projects in my 
resume which I had also mentioned during my introduction. I explained to him the important parts 
of the code which I could remember. Then he began asking me basic ML questions. 
Unfortunately, I had not revised those for a long time so I could only remember the answers in 
bits and pieces. I could see that he was partially satisfied with my answers.  
The other interviewer asked me basic coding questions and asked me to code and execute them 
on any editor. I chose VScode initially but later had to switch to the online compiler due to some 
2

issue with my editor. The first question that he asked me was how to calculate the length of a 
given string without using any predefined function of the string. It was an easy one I thought. But 
as I began implementing the logic I had no idea how to proceed. I thought for about 2-3 mins 
then came up with the solution. The solution was that I initialized a counter to 0 and a pointer to 
the first index of the string character. Till the character was not null I incremented the pointer as 
well as the counter. As the character became null, the while loop condition broke and the length 
of the string was printed on the terminal. He then asked variations of the same question and 
seemed to be satisfied with my answers. One important thing to note is that always think out loud 
while coding the given problem. Even if you are not able to solve the problem it’s alright but 
brainstorm verbally so that the interviewer can help you out in case of any difficulty. Also do not 
hesitate to take hints from the interviewers. 
The same interviewer then asked me basic CS fundamentals like what is a constructor and a 
destructor? what is constructor overloading? and does destructor overloading occur? I answered 
each of these questions with full explanation and he was satisfied with the answers 
The other interviewer began asking me basic SQL queries and their variations which I answered 
rather easily. My interview lasted for about an hour and in the end they asked if I had any 
questions for them. I asked 3 questions : How is a typical day in the life of a software engineer at 
Texas Instruments?. The second one was what is the career path of a software engineer at Texas 
Instruments and lastly I asked what were my areas of improvement during the interview? They 
answered all of my queries and I was satisfied. They wished me all the best for the results.  
I was satisfied with my interview but also nervous since I didn’t do well during the resume part of 
the interview. The results were announced in the evening at around 6pm and I was very happy to 
be one of the selected candidates. 
Important Points  
1.​ Review your resume well and revise your tech stack  and projects in detail 
2.​ Be clear in CS fundamentals : OOPS, DBMS, Operating Systems and DSA 
3.​ Practice the A2Z sheet / SDE sheet of striver for DSA coding questions 
4.​ Attend the PPT of the company. Questions may be asked based on the company and the 
role for which you are applying 
5.​ Request your seniors to take regular mockups so that they can point out your mistakes 
and suggest improvements. This helped me a lot 
6.​ Be confident and positive during your interview. Stress can lead you to make many silly 
errors 
3
